formal_statement: ∀ (t : ℕ → ℕ) (L : Language Bool), L ∈ PEqualNP.Library.DTIME t → ∃ c : ℕ, L ∈ PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.SIZE (fun n : ℕ => c * (t n + n + 1) ^ 3)
plain_statement: Every language decided within t(n) steps has, at every length n, a circuit of AND, OR, NOT gates of fan-in two with at most c (t(n) + n + 1)^3 gates, by unrolling the run step by step (a tableau). Standard (Savage 1972; Pippenger and Fischer 1979 for the t log t bound); the slack in the exponent covers the stack machine model. The quantitative step behind P inside P/poly and behind the natural proofs barrier.
title: Machines to circuits: DTIME(t) has circuits of size O((t + n)^3)
